irregularities_for_review.title: Bellagio optional staff gratuity buys extra chips - not recorded in canonical add_on rules
irregularities_for_review.detail: All three current Bellagio structure sheets (FRI $600, SAT title-$1,100, SUN $400) print an optional, at-registration-only staff gratuity that grants extra tournament chips ($40 -> +15,000 on FRI; $40 -> +20,000 on SAT; $25 -> +15,000 on SUN). The canonical rows carry add_on status "not_stated_in_sheet" for all three, so the tournaments table's spend-more-advantage classification misses this mechanic. The sheets also define the starting stack as inclusive of the optional gratuity (e.g., 30,000 = 15,000 + 15,000), so a player who declines pays less and starts short-stacked - a like-for-like comparison caveat.
irregularities_for_review.disposition: session-scoped finding only; canonical edit belongs to an integration session

irregularities_for_review.title: Current Bellagio Saturday sheet references a stale combined Day 2 date (9/13/26)
irregularities_for_review.detail: Rule 4 of the Saturday sheet linked from the live Bellagio poker page today prints "Combined Final Day 2 (9/13/26) will begin at 12pm at Bellagio" - a September 13, 2026 date on a sheet still published for recurring Saturday events. The page's own note says tournament play "will resume on Saturday, July 26, beginning with the $300 PLO Double Board Bomb Pot Tournament", so the linked recurring sheets predate the current series. Consumers cannot treat the sheet's Day-2/date statements as current-series facts.

irregularities_for_review.title: Wynn F1-week cancellation window (Nov 15-21, 2026) requires full deposit + 3-week cancellation on the read offer terms
irregularities_for_review.detail: The current official Wynn offer terms page states that reservations including a stay 11/15/2026-11/21/2026 are charged a full deposit of all room nights and tax at confirmation with a three-week cancellation policy; Dec 29-31, 2026 stays carry a 30-day policy. These are offer-specific terms on a page with an active validity window (Oct 2, 2026 - Mar 31, 2027); the general-booking default on the same page is 48 hours. Anyone booking during F1 week must re-read the terms on their own rate.
irregularities_for_review.disposition: recorded as dated cancellation evidence for the rate log's consumers

irregularities_for_review.title: Caesars publishes an official resort-fee range, not per-property amounts
irregularities_for_review.detail: Caesars' own corporate disclaimer states "a daily resort fee between $45-$60 plus applicable tax" for its properties and that the fee is waived for Diamond and Seven Stars tier members. The per-property /resort-fee URLs (e.g., caesars.com/caesars-palace/resort-fee) redirect to property homepages without fee text, so exact per-property amounts remain officially unpublished on caesars.com as of this read. Per-property blanks stay blank; the official range is the only citable official value.
irregularities_for_review.disposition: recorded; canonical per-property blanks stay blank pending a page that prints the exact amount
